name: Sky Blue Floral Printed Cotton Three Piece
description:
**Product Description**: Step into fresh, effortless elegance with this stunning ladies three piece set, thoughtfully created for style and comfort. The outfit is set against a serene light sky blue background crafted from soft, breathable cotton fabric. The complete ensemble includes a printed kameez, solid wide-leg trousers, and a coordinating printed cotton dupatta.

The kameez features an intricate vintage-inspired floral branch motif scattered throughout, highlighted by a rich embroidered V-placket neckline. Delicate embroidered borders accent the sleeve cuffs, adding a refined handcrafted appeal. The contrasting solid light blue wide-leg trousers provide a clean finish, while the lightweight dupatta—patterned with soft diagonal stripes and matching printed borders—drapes effortlessly over the shoulder.

Ideal for warm-weather gatherings, casual daytime events, or festive family occasions, this comfortable three piece outfit offers a graceful balance between traditional allure and modern daily wear.


**Styling Tip**: Pair this elegant three piece outfit with silver heels, delicate drop earrings, and a sleek wrist watch for an airy, polished look.


**Product Specifications**:

· Product Category: Three Piece (Kameez, Trouser & Dupatta Set)

· Fabric: Premium Cotton Blend

· Fit: Straight Fit Kameez with Wide-Leg Trousers

· Color: Sky Blue / Light Blue with earthy brown and coral floral accents

· Design/Pattern: Floral branch print kameez with embroidered neckline placket, solid trousers, and striped dupatta

· Occasion: Smart Casual, Daytime Festive Wear, Family Gatherings

· Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn

· Available Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

· Styling Tips: Style with nude or metallic heeled sandals and minimal silver jewelry.

· Care Instructions: Gentle hand wash in cold water or dry clean; do not bleach; line dry in shade; warm iron on reverse side.
